title: Exploring processing of baculovirus P10 protein using next-gen protein sequencing
summary: Case study from OET presents data illustrating the ability of QSI protein sequencing to add additional data richness to existing SDS-PAGE and Western blot data, providing deeper understanding of the baculovirus expression system.
body_markdown:
Explore this case study to see how the data presented illustrates the ability of Quantum Si’s single-molecule sequencing technology to add additional data richness to existing SDS-PAGE and Western blot data, which complements OET’s commitment to gaining a deeper understanding of the baculovirus expression system, allowing them to continue to innovate and further enhance their capabilities.


[Read the Case Study](https://www.quantum-si.com/wp-content/uploads/Q642_OET_customer_case_study.pdf)
